snippet.title: Cinderline - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626540/Cinderline/

This system is getting old. Drive on the Cinderline as an anthropomorphic bird, exploring strange towns as you journey to create the last S'MORE and bring its youthful delight to the Heart of the aging system.

As the system ages the ash falls and thing are not quite as they used to be.

Developer: Luke Kim, Zenon Ortiz
X: https://x.com/lukekdev
